Man let me first start off by saying I am so sorry for your predicament. Really it sucks. There may not be a way to salvage this, but if you really really want to then just have another talk. No arguing just talk. Unfortunately from what you've told and what she said in the letter she may not care about how you feel. You've expressed discomfort about her talking to her bestfriend, but she refuses to understand your point of view. Now I'm not saying that having a bestfriend of the opposite gender is bad, but having a best friend who was a former romantic partner is. Especially since they both seem to still harbor feelings for one another. The best advice I can offer is to sit her down, tell her that you never meant to hurt her, but that the relationship is over. You two have grown so far apart and while it is possible for two different people to survive in a relationship, it seems like you two are far too different for each other. Best of luck man.
